_meta.source: CUI Wah Campus Official Admission Guide

overview: CUI Wah Campus admissions are conducted 100% online through the official portal at admissions.comsats.edu.pk. There is no need to visit the campus to apply.

steps.title: Check Eligibility
steps.description: Before applying, verify that you meet the minimum eligibility requirements for your desired program. Engineering programs require 60% in HSSC. Computing and other programs require 50%.
tips: Check your HSSC percentage carefully
Pre-medical students may need to appear for additional math courses for Computing programs
O/A-Level students must obtain IBCC equivalence first

steps.title: Create Account on Admission Portal
steps.description: Visit admissions.comsats.edu.pk and create a new account using a valid, active email address. This email will be used for all future communication.
tips: Use a Gmail or professional email — avoid temporary emails
Remember your login credentials
Do NOT share your login details with anyone

steps.title: Fill the Online Admission Form
steps.description: Log in and complete the online admission form. Fill all fields accurately. Enter your name and father's name exactly as on your CNIC/B-Form/Matric certificate.
tips: Double-check spellings of name and father's name
Select your correct NAT test category based on your HSSC group
You can select more than one program choice in a single form
You can edit the form before final submission

steps.title: Pay Application Processing Fee
steps.description: Download and print the challan form from the portal. Deposit Rs. 2,500 (non-refundable) at any online bank branch listed on the challan.
tips: Fee is Rs. 2,500 per campus — if applying to multiple campuses, pay separately for each
Upload a clear, legible image of the paid challan on the portal
Keep the original challan safe

steps.title: Register for NTS Entry Test
steps.description: Register for the NAT (undergraduate) or GAT (graduate) entry test through CUI. Pay the NTS registration fee of Rs. 800 via the provided challan.
tips: If you have a valid previous NAT/GAT score, you may not need to re-register
NAT test category depends on what you studied in HSSC, NOT what program you are applying for
Aim to get the highest NTS score possible as it counts 50% of merit

steps.title: Submit the Form
steps.description: Review all information carefully, upload all required documents, and click 'Submit'. Once submitted, you cannot edit — contact admissions for any changes.
tips: Do NOT submit until all documents are uploaded
After submission, check portal regularly for verification status
Look for: 'Your application is successfully verified'

steps.title: Appear in NTS Entry Test
steps.description: Print your NTS roll number slip from the portal and appear in the test on the scheduled date at the designated center.
tips: Bring roll slip + original CNIC/B-Form to the test center
Arrive at least 30 minutes early
You can appear in both test dates to improve your score

steps.title: Check Merit List
steps.description: Merit lists are displayed on the admission portal. Log in on August 18, 2025 (1st merit list date) to check your status.
tips: Merit = Matric 10% + HSSC 40% + NAT 50%
If selected, download your offer letter immediately
If not selected in 1st list, watch for 2nd and 3rd merit lists

steps.title: Pay Admission Dues
steps.description: If selected, download and pay the admission dues challan within the specified deadline. Failure to pay by the deadline means forfeiting your seat.
tips: Dues deadline is strictly enforced
Pay at any HBL, ABL, or MCB branch listed on your challan
Upload payment proof on the portal

steps.title: Submit Documents to Campus
steps.description: Submit attested copies of required documents to the CUI Wah Admissions Office. This can be done at the start of classes.
required_documents: Two passport-size photographs (1 attested on back)
SSC/Matric Certificate and Mark Sheet (attested copy) or O-Level IBCC Equivalence
HSSC/Intermediate Certificate and Mark Sheet (attested copy) or A-Level IBCC Equivalence
Affidavit (Rs. 20/50 stamp paper) — for result-awaiting students

common_mistakes: Spelling errors in name or father's name (must match CNIC/Matric exactly)
Uploading blurry or incomplete document images
Not uploading paid challan image after paying fee
Selecting wrong NAT test category (must match HSSC group, not desired program)
Not clicking Submit after completing the form
Applying with a supply (supplementary) in HSSC Part-1 — this makes you ineligible
Not monitoring the portal for objections after submission
multiple_campus_policy: You can apply to multiple CUI campuses. Each campus requires a separate form and Rs. 2,500 processing fee. However, one NTS roll number can be used for all campuses within the same session.
result_awaiting_policy: F.Sc Part-2 result-awaiting students may apply using Part-1 results, provided there is no 'F' grade in any subject. Admission is provisional and will be cancelled if minimum required marks are not achieved in the final result.
application_portal_issue: If the portal is unresponsive, try a different browser (Chrome, Firefox). If the issue persists, email admissions@ciitwah.edu.pk with screenshots.
